title: KitLanguagePlugin
description: more lunguage for my plugins more plugins soon
body:
LanguagePlugin
Shared player language for all your Paper plugins. One /language command, one file — Home, TPA, and any future plugin read the same setting.

Supports remote updates: publish language-pack.yml on GitHub and servers download new translations and new plugin support without rebuilding the jar.

Features
/language <english|hebrew|french|spanish> — set your language once
/lang — alias for /language
Shared storage — plugins/SharedLanguage/player-languages.yml
Works with HomePlugin, TpaPlugin, and more
Remote language pack — update messages and add new plugins from a URL
Version lock — new plugins can require LanguagePlugin 1.1.0+ so old jars do not get new features until players update
Bukkit API — other plugins can read language via LanguageAPI or PluginLanguages helper
Commands
Command	Description
/language english
Set language to English
/language hebrew
Set language to Hebrew
/language french
Set language to French
/language spanish
Set language to Spanish
/lang hebrew
Same as /language
